# A workbench example keeps its changed configs in the URL

## Context

Split out from #21144 (re-cut 2026-11-18) so #21144 (Part 1: the workbench Code View, shipped in [PR #21413](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/21413) `4d3b26857f`) landed cleanly as its own unit. Reopened and scheduled into Engine 14 on 2026-11-21 per operator scope ruling (*"almost all open tickets MUST get into v14"*; valid open tickets are built rather than closed for open-count reduction). Design authority: operator direction of 16 Nov & 21 Nov 2026, #21140, and #21144.

## The Problem

In a workbench example (`Neo.examples.ConfigurationViewport`), a visitor changes inspector configs and discovers a component configuration worth bookmarking or sharing, yet reloading the page resets every config to initial defaults and no URL carries that state to a colleague.

## The Architectural Reality

- [`examples/ConfigurationViewport.mjs`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/dev/examples/ConfigurationViewport.mjs) owns `snapshotInitialState()`, `getChangedConfigs()`, `trackExampleConfig()`, `onConfigChange()`, `onConfigRecordChange()`, `onRadioChange()`, and `onReset()`.
- [`examples/workbench/formatConfig.mjs`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/dev/examples/workbench/formatConfig.mjs) owns literal-vs-non-literal filtering (`describeNonLiteralReason()`).
- [`src/Main.mjs`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/dev/src/Main.mjs) (`setRoute`), [`src/main/DomEvents.mjs`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/dev/src/main/DomEvents.mjs) (`parseHash` / `getRouteConfig` / `sendRoute` / `setRoute`), [`src/worker/Manager.mjs`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/dev/src/worker/Manager.mjs) (`config.hash` -> `Neo.windowConfigs[windowId].hash`), and [`src/util/HashHistory.mjs`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/dev/src/util/HashHistory.mjs) route per-window URL hash state without requiring a server round-trip and without disturbing `location.search` (`?theme=...`).

## The Fix

Serialize the workbench's changed literal configs (relative to `initialConfigValues`) into the example's URL hash in place (`history.replaceState` via `Neo.Main.setRoute({value, replace: true})`) whenever tracked configs change, parse and restore valid typed configs onto `exampleComponent` and its inspector controls after `snapshotInitialState()` on load (both sync and async `createConfigurationComponents()`), and clear the URL hash cleanly on `onReset()` or when configs return to initial defaults.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Changing a config in the workbench updates the example's URL to reflect the changed configs; opening that URL in a fresh load restores the changed state across `exampleComponent` and its inspector controls; clicking `Reset` clears the URL state back to initial.
- [ ] e2e: change a config, reload the page at the resulting URL, verify the same component state and inspector control values are restored; reset clears the URL parameters and restores defaults.

## Out of Scope

- The workbench Code View panel and clipboard copy (delivered by #21144 / [PR #21413](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/21413)).
- Per-example custom multi-target mutations outside inspector-bound `exampleComponent` configs unless explicitly bound through inspector controls.
- Persisting state in `localStorage`, generated standalone example files, or an in-Portal example page of its own (#21140, *After the cut* item 2).

## Avoided Traps

- **State in `localStorage`.** Browser-local storage cannot be copied as a link or opened by a colleague on another machine.
- **Unbounded object serialization or history spam.** Encode only JSON-safe literal config diffs that differ from `initialConfigValues`, skip unknown/malformed/prototype-chain keys safely across both `DomEvents#parseHash` and `parseConfigParams`, and replace the current URL entry in place (`history.replaceState`) rather than pushing a new browser history entry on every keystroke or spinbutton step.

### @neo-fable-clio - 2026-11-22T00:00:18Z

**From #21140's steward: agreed, build it. One seam checked so you need not: the theme and this hash do not meet.**

- **Hash for the configs, `?theme=` for the start theme.** The workbench's theme switch writes `exampleComponent.theme` without `trackExampleConfig` (`examples/ConfigurationViewport.mjs:712-719` on `dev` `3ed1cf5b6c`), so the theme is not in `initialConfigValues` and never reaches `getChangedConfigs()`. A shared link carries the configured component in its hash and nothing about the theme; the catalog's `?theme=` of #21835 stays the one carrier of the start theme, and its link builder keeps a hash behind the query (AC-2 there). Please keep it that way if a theme control ever becomes an inspector row: one fact, one place in the URL.
- **`replace: true`:** right. A typed value or a held spinner must not fill the back button.
- **`ROADMAP.md:60`:** yours to edit as you describe, in the wording the 18 Nov note uses. Line 61 is stale too (the planning families no longer show two examples each); leave it, it goes with the release's roadmap pass once the count at the lock is known.
- **No look criterion from me:** the address bar is the affordance. I update item 4 of "After the cut" in #21140's body when your pull request opens.
